result:
Post revisions are in. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (9 tests, 7 of them new for this feature), and `bunx guren gate` passes all six stages.

- **Keeping versions:** a successful edit saves the post's previous title, excerpt and body as a revision. Creating a post saves nothing. An edit that fails validation (422) or comes from someone else (403) is stopped before anything is saved. Revisions are kept even when a save changes nothing, since you said that case won't be checked.
- **History page:** `GET /posts/:id/revisions` lists `{ id, title, createdAt }`, newest first. The post page has a "History" link next to Edit. I sort by row id rather than `created_at`, because two edits in the same millisecond get the same timestamp.
- **Restore:** `POST /posts/:id/revisions/:revisionId/restore` saves the current version as a new revision, puts the chosen one back, and redirects to `/posts/:id`. The restored revision stays in the list.
- **Access:** both routes sit in the same signed-in group as editing, so guests go to `/login`. Anyone other than the author gets 403. A revision that belongs to a different post gets 404, even when the same author owns both.
- **Delete:** deleting a post removes its revisions first. The foreign key also has ON DELETE CASCADE, but SQLite only applies that when foreign-key enforcement is on, so I didn't rely on it.

Saving the revision and updating the post are two separate writes, not one transaction. If the second write fails, you get an extra revision, but nothing is lost.

I added a `post_revisions` table to `db/schema.ts` with a generated migration (`db/migrations/20260925024738_add_post_revisions/`). The new files are a `PostRevision` model with a `keep(post)` helper, `PostRevisionController` (`index` and `restore`), `PostRevisionResource`, and the `posts/Revisions.tsx` page. I also added a `PostRevisionParamSchema` validator and a `viewRevisions` rule in `PostPolicy`, and registered the two routes in `routes/web.ts`. `PostController` now saves a revision in `update` and deletes a post's revisions in `destroy`, and `Show.tsx` has the History link. Codegen updated the `.guren/*.gen.ts` files. The tests are in `tests/PostRevisionController.test.ts`. I deleted the `docs/spec/` folder that `spec:generate` created, because the project didn't have one.
